en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with people walking and gathering around a central statue fountain. On the left stands a tall clock‑towered building with an ornate façade and arched windows. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey gabled houses and commercial buildings with German‑style architecture. Shop signs are visible at street level, and trees line parts of the square.
